notes:
Adversarial check of research_R1.json (39 rules, 10 discrepancies). I used exactly 12 WebSearch calls. data/visadocs.yaml served as the manual-derived primary, and research_R3/R4b/R6 were cross-read; I did not treat them as primaries unless they quoted manual or notice text.

Main outcomes:
(1) Baselines are solid. 2025 GNI 52,416,000 (BOK, press) and 2024 49,955,000 are confirmed. A separate official immigration.go.kr document (remote-work visa, 1.5x = 7,862만원) corroborates that KIS uses 52.416M now. All GNI-multiple arithmetic in R1 is correct.
(2) The E-7 GNI exception (49.955M until 2027-03) is UNVERIFIED. It is reproduced by migrant centres but has no primary copy, and there is an unverified counter-claim. My two searches found nothing official either way. Do not hard-code it: show E-7 GNI tests as multiples or ranges (3x: ₩149.9M-157.2M). If it holds, the amount is almost surely 49,955,000 (the '4,995만원' label truncates 4,995.5만원).
(3) The 2026 E-7 wage floors are confirmed: 31.12M / 25.89M / 25.89M / 26M from 2026-02-01, fixed amounts not GNI shares. R1's 'E-7-2/3 = minimum wage' derivation is not exact; do not publish it.
(4) The most important correction is F-2-R. The income alternative is now the regional living wage (생활임금), not 70% of GNI. data/visamap.yaml line 1353 'income: {gni: 0.7, ...}' is likely wrong, and R1's discrepancy 8 is refuted (the existing 'regional-wage income' text is closer to correct).
(5) The F-5-6 naturalization route belongs to F-5-7. F-5-13 has no asset route (manual document list). Income and assets never add together, and assets need 6+ months' holding (manual).
(6) The own-share >= 50% rule is manual-confirmed only for F-5-6. A lead says F-5-16 and F-5-13 count only the applicant, which matches the data's F-5-16 {gni: 2} without a household flag.
(7) Still open: median household net assets for F-5-2/F-5-27 (private estimate about 2.6억, 55% of the average; no official figure found); the F-5-6 70% and 60% tiers (secondary only); the F-5-27 criteria (single case-summary source); F-2-99 40M/20M and the F-2-7 40M waiver (leads only); the E-7 ministry-recommendation 1.5x waiver (leads only); the F-5-1 own-vs-household question.
